title: A mixed valence decanuclear cerium-oxo cluster Ce4IIICe6IV for efficient photocurrent response

synthesis.procedure: A 1 mmol/3 mL methanol solution of CeCl3 was prepared by dissolving CeCl3·6H2O (354.56 mg/mmol) in MeOH. Next, 3 mL of this solution was transferred into an 8 mL vial. Hacac (2.00 mmol, 205 µL) was added and the mixture shaken until homogeneous. Et3N (3.00 mmol, 412 µL) was added slowly dropwise. The vial was sealed, sonicated for 1 minute, and kept at 2–6 °C. Brown block crystals formed after 1 day. The main text describes the same low-temperature crystallization from CeCl3·6H2O, Hacac, and Et3N in methanol, with Et3N added last, but does not give reagent amounts.

reagents.name: cerium(III) chloride hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 1 mmol (3 mL of a 1 mmol/3 mL methanol solution; 354.56 mg/mmol)

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brown block crystals obtained after one day at 2–6 °C.

properties.summary: The solid shows strong diffuse-reflectance absorption from 200 to 450 nm that extends beyond 800 nm, with an optical band gap of about 1.82 eV. An ITO electrode prepared from the cluster gives a clear, reversible photocurrent under a 300 W xenon lamp, with a transient photocurrent density of 0.98 μA cm−2 at 0.5 V in 0.50 mol L−1 Na2SO4, attributed to light absorption and CeIII/CeIV redox-assisted charge separation. No magnetic data are reported.

measurements.name: diffuse-reflectance absorption range
measurements.value: 200–450 nm strong absorption, extending beyond 800 nm

measurements.name: optical band gap
measurements.conditions: derived from the diffuse reflectance spectrum (Fig. 5a insert)

measurements.name: transient photocurrent density
measurements.conditions: ITO working electrode, 0.5 V, 0.50 mol L−1 Na2SO4, 300 W xenon lamp, repetitive on/off illumination
